subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Of Shakespeare's education is known little. (b) William Shakespeare was born on April 23, 1564 in Stratford on Avon. (c) His mother Mary Arden was the daughter of a prosperous family. (d) When he was 14, his father lost his property and fell into debt. (e) She was eight years older than he. (f) His father John Shakespeare was a farmer's son. (g) In 1582 Shakespeare married Anne Hathway, the daughter of a peasant family. (h) His real teachers were man and women and the natural influences which surrouned him in Stratford.
guide_solution: b → f → c → a → h → d → g → e William Shakespeare was born on April 23, 1564 in Stratford on Avon. His father John Shakespeare was a farmer's son. His mother Mary Arden was the daughter of a prosperous family. Of Shakespeare's education is known little. His real teachers were man and women and the natural influences which surrouned him in Stratford. When he was 14, his father lost his property and fell into debt. In 1582 Shakespeare married Anne Hathway, the daughter of a peasant family. She was eight years older than he.
